summary: Whatcom County, WA cupola cabin built 1927 or 1928 on a rocky summit; removed or destroyed 1966-67; only rubble remains, reached by a popular hiking trail.

facts.status_note: Cabin removed or destroyed in 1966-1967; outbuildings are now rubble

access.note: Popular hiking trail from the end of Forest Road 3040; no closure found in the sources read

visit.trail_note: About 4.2 miles; WillhiteWeb warns the trail runs along a cliff edge near the end

events.note: Permanent camp for six people built near the summit by U.S. Forest rangers; not a lookout

125 visitors that season, per a 1936 item and WillhiteWeb

Register says removed in 1967; firelookout.com says destroyed in 1967; WillhiteWeb says destroyed in 1966 or 1967
Registered March 25, 2012 as FFLOS US 1232; nominated by Ray Kresek

notes_for_editor: Built year conflicts: register and firelookout.com say 1927; WillhiteWeb says 1928 for a D-6 cupola cabin. Removal conflicts: register says removed 1967, firelookout.com says destroyed 1967, WillhiteWeb says 1966 or 1967. Forest Lookouts lists a Bellingham Filter Center (March 28, 1942 to October 16, 1943) on the same page without saying how it relates to this site, so it is not in the story as a fact about the lookout. Trail access is from a trip-report site (WillhiteWeb); no official closure or current status found. Record status 'gone' and coordinates match the sources. No web search was used for this tower; the four cited pages were read, plus the firelookout.org Washington list for the record check.
